name: pr-2686
title: PR #2686 — #1182 + #2039 step 2: the anchored step, latest points move, the button never repeats (analytic)

cases.title: A thin 10° triangle is readable at every configuration
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» six times. The arc at B reads 10° every time; every drawing is a thin but readable triangle, no two vertices nearly on top of each other. (Right after «∢ABC = 10» the triangle is redrawn as a different one, because meeting 10° in place would leave a 5.9° corner.)
cases.before: Prod opens on a triangle with a 5.9° corner, and two of 24 configurations have a corner past 165°.

cases.title: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» never repeats the picture
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» twelve times: every press changes the picture.
cases.before: Two presses could show the same drawing.

cases.title: The circle stays put when a triangle is drawn around it
lines: משולש ABC חוסם את מעגל O
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After the second line the circle does not move; the triangle appears around it.

cases.title: A given length moves only the last point
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «AB = 5», A and C stay exactly where they were; only B moves.

cases.title: An equal side moves only C
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «AB = AC», A and B stay; C moves.

cases.title: A stated angle turns only C
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «זווית A = 50», A stays; C turns about A (B moves only if the triangle would otherwise be a sliver).

cases.title: A rectangle keeps its first corner
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «AB = 6», A stays; the rectangle stretches from A.
cases.before: Every corner moves, at some configurations by a lot.

cases.title: A sector keeps O and A and turns B
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «זווית AOB = 60», O and A stay; B turns about O.

cases.title: Points placed by a stated length stay put
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After the third line, A and B stay exactly; only C turns.

cases.title: A point on a side keeps its place along the side
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». After «AB = 5», A and C stay; B moves; D stays at the same place along BC.

cases.title: A free point is drawn near the figure
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». A and B fill most of the view (M opens on the midpoint of AB). Press «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on M's row: «המקום הגיאומטרי של M: ישר · 3x + 4y - 25 = 0», with the line drawn dashed (the view widens to hold it). Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» a few times: M moves along that line, and A and B never shrink to a corner.
cases.before: At the opening configuration A and B take 39 % of the view, and the locus withholds its equation.

cases.title: REFUSAL — a contradicting length is still refused
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». «AB = 7» is refused: «לא ניתן: «AB = 7» סותר את «AB = 5» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד. הסיבה: |AB| = 7.», and the triangle is unchanged.

cases.title: A fixed triangle has no other configuration
cases.lookFor: Start with «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת»: the tool says «זו התצורה היחידה שמצאתי — הנתונים שכתבתם קובעים את השרטוט.», and the triangle does not move.
